phrases.en: “Adonoy Sfatai (O God, my lips) open” (Psalms 51:17). This
phrases.enMatch: “Adonoy Sfatai (O God, my lips) open” (Psalms 51:17). This
phrases.info: ““Adonoy Sfatai (O God, my lips) open” (Psalms 51:17). This” — "Adnai sfasai tiftach" (Tehillim 51:17) — 'Hashem, open my lips' — is the bechinah of the rikudim (dances) of a chasunah (wedding). Rabbeinu unfolds this as follows: (1) The kallah as 320 dinim. As long as a woman is not given to zivug, she is called "na'ar" without ה (Zohar Bo 38b) — gematria 320 (5 × 64), corresponding to the 320 dinim (judgments). When she is prepared for zivug, she is called "na'arah" with ה — because the dinim are sweetened via the ה = the 5 alafin of אהיה that are in Binah (Pri Etz Chayim, Sha'ar Amidah). Every bride at her wedding is, spiritually, in the bechinah of na'ar = 320 dinim; she must be rectified to become na'arah, and this is accomplished via rikudim (danci

phrases.info: “She becomes the aspect of Adonoy, naarah, fitting for union” — "Adnai sfasai tiftach" (Tehillim 51:17) — 'Hashem, open my lips' — is the bechinah of the rikudim (dances) of a chasunah (wedding). Rabbeinu unfolds this as follows: (1) The kallah as 320 dinim. As long as a woman is not given to zivug, she is called "na'ar" without ה (Zohar Bo 38b) — gematria 320 (5 × 64), corresponding to the 320 dinim (judgments). When she is prepared for zivug, she is called "na'arah" with ה — because the dinim are sweetened via the ה = the 5 alafin of אהיה that are in Binah (Pri Etz Chayim, Sha'ar Amidah). Every bride at her wedding is, spiritually, in the bechinah of na'ar = 320 dinim; she must be rectified to become na'arah, and this is accomplished via rikudim (danci
